svg.text: A Value is one 64-bit word, and the low bits say what it is
Signed integer (62 bits), stored as n << 2
Heap block pointer (61 bits), compared by identity
Heap block pointer (61 bits), compared by value
rotl(bits + BIAS, 4), all 64 bits, see below
The 5-bit subtag makes the whole low byte a per-type constant: nil is 0x05, undef 0x0D,
Bit 1 is the compare by value bit. It is set only where equality is not a word compare:
flonums, strings and boxed numbers. So eq is a mask test plus a word compare, and
every other combination of types falls out correct for free.
